fetchedHero.name: Medusa
fetchedHero.specialAbility: At the start of your turn, you may deal 1 damage to an opposing fighter in Medusa's zone.
fetchedHero.description: The Gorgon with the gaze that felled thousands. With her harpies at her side, you better have a defense in hand when she turns her eyes to you.

ru.title: Мимолётный взгляд
ru.effect: Нанесите 2 урона любому бойцу в зоне Медузы.

card.title: A Momentary Glance
card.effect: Deal 2 damage to any one fighter in Medusa's zone.

ru.title: Крылатое буйство
ru.effect: Переместите всех ваших бойцов на расстояние до 3 ячеек. Можете перемещать их через ячейки, занятые бойцами противника. Затем верните поверженную Гарпию (если есть) на любую ячейку в зоне Медузы.

card.title: Winged Frenzy
card.effect: Move each of your fighters up to 3 spaces. You may move them through spaces containing opposing fighters. Then, return a defeated Harpy (if any) to any space in Medusa's zone.

ru.title: Убийственный взор
ru.effectAfter: Если вы победили в бою, нанесите бойцу, которого вы атаковали, 8 единиц урона.

card.title: Gaze of Stone
card.effectAfter: If you won the combat, deal 8 damage to the opposing fighter.

card.title: Feint
card.effectImmediately: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

ru.title: Передышка
ru.effectAfter: Возьмите 1 карту. Если вы победили в бою, вместо этого возьмите 2 карты.

card.title: Regroup
card.effectAfter: Draw 1 card. If you won the combat, draw 2 cards instead.

ru.title: Гончие могучего Зевса
ru.effectAfter: Переместите каждую Гарпию на расстояние до 3 ячеек.

card.title: The Hounds of Mighty Zeus
card.effectAfter: Move each Harpy up to 3 spaces.

ru.title: Рывок
ru.effectAfter: Переместите вашего бойца, участвовавшего в бою, на расстояние до 3 ячеек.

card.title: Dash
card.effectAfter: Move your fighter up to 3 spaces.

otherSetHeroes.name: Alice
otherSetHeroes.specialAbility:
When you place Alice, choose whether she starts the game BIG or SMALL.
When Alice is BIG, add 2 to the value of her attack cards.
When Alice is SMALL, add 1 to the value of her defense cards.
otherSetHeroes.description: Big trouble in a little package. She's been through the looking glass and came back with a vorpal blade and the Jabberwock in tow. Catch her at the wrong size, and it'll be checkmate for you.

otherSetHeroes.name: Sinbad
otherSetHeroes.specialAbility: When you maneuver, you may move fighters +1 space for each VOYAGE card in your discard pile.
otherSetHeroes.description: With every thrilling voyage, he grows in wisdom and power. Get to him and the faithful Porter quickly, before his experience makes him nigh unstoppable and your story ends too soon.

otherSetHeroes.name: King Arthur
otherSetHeroes.specialAbility:
When King Arthur attacks, you may BOOST that attack, Play the BOOST card, face down, along with your attack card.
If your opponent cancels the effects on your attack card, the BOOST is discarded without effect.
otherSetHeroes.description: With mighty Excalibur in his mailed fist and the tricky Merlin at his back, his greatest weapon is his faith and willingness to sacrifice to see that deed is done.

heroStory.story:
I am Medusa, a creature of both beauty and terror, born of gods and cursed by fate. My story begins in the ancient realm of Greece, where I once walked as a mortal maiden blessed with unparalleled beauty. With cascading locks of serpentine hair and eyes that gleamed like polished emeralds, I captivated the hearts of all who beheld me. Yet, little did they know of the darkness that lay beneath my enchanting facade.

One fateful day, I caught the eye of the sea god Poseidon. His lustful desires led him to desecrate the temple of Athena, where I sought refuge. In her fury, the goddess cursed me, transforming my once-golden tresses into a writhing nest of venomous snakes and condemning me to turn any who gazed upon me to stone. Thus, I became the infamous monster feared by all.

Loneliness became my constant companion as I wandered the desolate lands, shunned by society and haunted by my own reflection. Yet, amidst the anguish, a glimmer of hope emerged. Perseus, a brave hero, sought to slay me and claim glory for himself. In our climactic encounter, he wielded the reflective shield gifted by Athena, using it to evade my petrifying gaze.

In the end, it was not the blade of Perseus that brought about my demise, but the cunning of Athena herself. Guided by the wisdom of the gods, he severed my head, freeing me from the curse that bound me to this wretched existence. In death, I found redemption, my spirit finally released from the shackles of fate.

Though my tale may be one of tragedy, it serves as a cautionary reminder of the consequences of vanity and hubris. I am Medusa, once a victim of circumstance, now a cautionary tale etched into the annals of history.

card.effect: Search your deck and discard pile for the EXCALIBUR card. Add it to your hand. If you searched your deck, shuffle it.

card.title: Prophecy
card.effect: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 2 of them to your hand and put the other 2 back on top of your deck, in any order.

card.title: Momentous Shift
card.effectDuring: If your fighter started this turn in a different space, this card's value is 5 instead.

card.effectAfter: You may place your fighter in any space.

card.effect: Move each fighter up to 3 spaces. (This includes opposing fighters.)

card.effectAfter: Move your fighter up to 4 spaces.

card.title: Aid the Chosen One
card.effectAfter: If you won the combat, draw 2 cards.

card.title: Divine Intervention
card.effectAfter: Move King Arthur up to 5 spaces.

card.title: Feint
card.effectImmediately: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

card.title: Noble Sacrifice
card.effectDuring: You may BOOST this attack. (This is in addition to any boost from King Arthur's special ability.)

card.title: Restless Spirits
card.effect: Choose any space in Merlin's zone. Deal 2 damage to each opposing fighter in that space and in one adjacent space. If at least one fighter is defeated this way, draw 1 card.

card.title: Skirmish
card.effectAfter: If you won the combat, choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 2 spaces.

card.title: The Holy Grail
card.effectAfter: If King Arthur has 4 or less health but is not defeated, set his health to 8.
